QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Dueling with Brother Sondal
QuestInfo.0: Brother Sondal has offered to duel you himself.
QuestInfo.1: A duel with brother Sondal! This is an amazing opportunity.
QuestInfo.2: You went up against brother Sondal, but only his clone. That did feel a little too easy...

default.0: We usually don't let the youngest duel, but it's a special occasion. Let's just keep this between you and me, eh? Let me know when you're ready!
